integrity: Proof by unique degree-two pinching, Frobenius torsion difference, unpointed automorphism quotient, and Burnside fixed-point counts. Program reproduces representative finite checks. Independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Fixed maximal elliptic normalization over a square prime field, primes at least five, one nonsplit node; does not count other normalizations or embedded presentations. Finite code checks are not a proof for all primes.
title: Isomorphism and automorphism spectra of maximal one-nodal curves with elliptic normalization
